is a 5 reel, 4 row slot with spinning reels and 1,024 ways to win. Grizzly Stampede comes with Multiplier Wilds, the Stampede feature, the Super Stampede feature, the stateful Totem feature, and the Bonus- and Super Bonus games with Bonus spins. In the Bonus game, each reel can individually expand from 4 to 6 rows, increasing the number of ways to win up to a maximum of 7,776.

X-iter rules
The X-iter feature offers different game modes.
SUPER BONUS:
Guaranteed Super Bonus trigger at the cost of __X05_MULTIPLIER__ the selected bet.
BONUS:
Guaranteed Bonus trigger at the cost of __X04_MULTIPLIER__ the selected bet.
GRIZZLY STAMPEDE:
Guaranteed Totem feature trigger releasing the Grizzly Spirit at the cost of __X03_MULTIPLIER__ the selected bet.
MEGA HUNT:
More than 15 times the chance to trigger the Bonus game at the cost of __X02_MULTIPLIER__ the selected bet.
BONUS HUNT:
More than 4 times the chance to trigger the Bonus game at the cost of __X01_MULTIPLIER__ the selected bet.
The X-iter features can only be activated in the base game.
The minimum X-iter cost is __MINBABMODE__
